svg.title: What-if exploration and rehearsal
svg.desc: What can be tried before acting in the real setting? Separate learning how a system responds, constructing a hypothetical world, and rehearsing a person's activity. Source illustration: Preservice teachers rehearse classroom discussion with represented students and a persistent dialogue history.

text.tspan: What can be tried before acting in the real setting?
Lets people try hypothetical changes, probe a system's behaviour or
practise in a simulated setting and inspect what happens.
